title: The School Ghost
lines: Meg had a class in the old school.
Kids said a ghost lived in the halls.
At night it made a long, sad sound.
The cook said it was just a machine.
But Meg did not think that was it.
"Can we go and look?" she asked Mom.
That night they went back in.
Mom and Meg went down the dark hall.
It was still. No sound at all.
Meg felt let down. Then it came again.
It came from a door in the back.
Meg gave the door a hard tug.
Mom held the lamp. Green eyes shone!
It was a cat, stuck since lunch.
Meg fed it. Her school ghost sat and ate.

questions.ask: What did the kids say lived in the school?
questions.listenFor: A ghost, in the halls. Line two says it.

questions.ask: What was really making the sad sound?
questions.listenFor: A cat, stuck in back of a door since lunch. The cook had guessed a machine.

questions.ask: What would you take with you to look? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. Meg took a lamp and her mom.
